# Support

> 🌐 Language: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](SUPPORT.vi.md)

## Where to ask

Use the issue templates for reproducible bugs, focused feature proposals, and technical questions. Include hardware, runtime versions, profile, seed, status code, and relevant sanitized logs when applicable.

## In scope

- Reproducing the documented Kaggle T4×2 REST workflow.
- API contract, queue behavior, authentication, and qualification evidence.
- Documentation or CI problems.

## Out of scope

- Debugging unrelated cloud environments without a minimal reproduction.
- Requests to weaken authentication or expose the internal worker publicly.
- Claims that FP16 or 1024×1024 are supported without new qualification evidence.
- Requests for private tokens, accounts, or unpublished infrastructure.
